h1: 7 Best Danube View Hotels in Budapest (2026)
h1_main: 7 Best Danube View Hotels in Budapest
author_role: 7 riverside hotels compared on the price of a river-view room, which rooms face the water and guest scores
lead: A "Danube view hotel" in Budapest often turns out to have a view only from some rooms, and the cheapest rate is usually for the courtyard side. So this page compares the price of the cheapest room that actually faces the river, for the same night. The best value is a small hotel where every room looks at the Parliament (that is Victoria, the #1 pick, €136); the big names on the Pest bank face the castle instead. This page gets you to the right one in under a minute.

I compared all 7 on what decides a river-view stay: which room types face the Danube, what you see (Parliament, castle or Margaret Island), the price of that room, guest scores and the walk to the centre, all from each hotel's live listing. Filter by Buda or Pest bank, Parliament view or price below, or scroll straight to the ranking.

guide.html:

What the numbers say: for the Parliament view you want the Buda bank, and it is the cheaper side: Park Plaza (€96), Novotel (€130) and Victoria (€136). The Pest-bank 5-stars look across at the castle and cost €207–329. Victoria and the Marriott are the only two where every room faces the river.

• The Parliament view for the least money, every room: #1 Victoria.
  • A castle view from every room, 5-star: #2 Marriott.
  • A river view plus an indoor pool: #3 InterContinental.
  • The best-rated stay by the Chain Bridge: #4 Leon (9.4).
  • The cheapest river-view room: #5 Park Plaza (€96).
  • A balcony over the river: #7 Four Points.

Want the river from the water instead? Compare the Budapest river cruises, or the Castle District hotels up on the hill.

guide.h2: Before You Book: Getting the View You Pay For
guide.html:
Book the room type, not the hotel: at InterContinental, Leon, Park Plaza and Novotel the cheapest rate is a room without a river view. Pick a room with "River View", "Danube View" or the Parliament in its name.

Which bank: from the Buda bank (Bem rakpart, Lánchíd utca) you look at the Parliament; from the Pest bank (Apáczai Csere János utca) you look at the castle and the Chain Bridge.

At night: the Parliament, the castle and the bridges are lit up after dark, the best time for the view.

faqs.q: Which Budapest hotel has the best Danube view?
faqs.a: Boutique Hotel Victoria is our #1: every room is a RiverView room facing the Danube and the Parliament, from €136 a night. Budapest Marriott Hotel gives every one of its 364 rooms a river view on the Pest side, from €329.

faqs.q: Which hotel in Budapest has a view of the Parliament?
faqs.a: The hotels on the Buda bank face it: Boutique Hotel Victoria (all rooms), Park Plaza Budapest and Novotel Budapest Danube (rooms with a river or Parliament view).

faqs.q: What is the cheapest hotel with a Danube view in Budapest?
faqs.a: Park Plaza Budapest, with a Superior Double Room with River View from €96 for 2 adults on a March weeknight.

faqs.q: Do all rooms have a river view?
faqs.a: Only at Victoria and Budapest Marriott. At the other hotels here, choose a room type with a river, Danube or Parliament view in its name.

faqs.q: Is it better to stay on the Buda or Pest side for views?
faqs.a: Buda for a view of the Parliament, Pest for a view of the castle and the Chain Bridge. The Pest bank is closer to the restaurants and shopping streets.

faqs.q: Which Danube view hotel has a pool?
faqs.a: InterContinental Budapest has an indoor pool and spa, with river-view rooms from €207.
